Don't let the rising RAM and GPU prices deter you from upgrading to a gaming PC that you deserve. Look hard enough and there are still good deals to be found. Case in point, Newegg via Walmart is currently offering a Thermaltake GeForce RTX 5070 Gaming PC for just $1,499.99 with free shipping. Currently, this is the best price I can find for a RTX 5070 prebuilt.

The Thermaltake LGCS RTX 5070 Gaming PC Drops to $1,400

The Thermaltake LGCS gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core i5-14400F CPU, GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5-6000MHz RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD. The Intel Core i5-14400F CPU is a previous generation CPU with 10 total cores and a max turbo frequency of 4.7GHz. It's a solid gaming chip when paired with a discrete graphics card.

The GeForce RTX 5070 GPU is an excellent choice for 1080p or 1440p gaming

The GeForce RTX 5070 is the best value Nvidia card for 1080p and 1440p gaming and by itself this card retails for $600 (although generally it's higher these days). It's also powerful enough to run most games at 4K, although at that point you'll see noticeable gains jumping up to a 5070 Ti. Compared to the previous generation GPUs, the RTX 5070 offers a slight performance improvement over the RTX 4070 Super, which was and still is an excellent GPU. The fps gain is greater in games that support DLSS 4.5 with multi-frame generation. Check out our RTX 5070 review.
